about_the_game:
Game name "Strange Dreams", game reminder/communication group 1032181602

Shareholders and audience grandfathers! The game is expected to be released on September 19th, and there will be some activities to send free activation codes before the release!! The more wish lists you send, the more you send!! Please add to the group and pay attention to the notification. If you have any ideas or creativity, be sure to drop them in the comment section or join the group (1032181602) for discussion! Your suggestions are the core driving force for making the game better! Don't forget to pay attention to the development progress, and the three consecutive hints [doge] are the greatest spiritual support for the development team! The Strange Dream cannot be separated from the strong help of all the grandfathers! See you in our group, let's polish this nuclear dream together!

Main style:

Chinese Dream Core, Children's Core, Old Core, Concrete Core, Toilet Core, Threshold Space, etc., focusing on nostalgic tearful eyes+Chinese core art+a small amount of melancholy/micro horror elements (not intended to be terrifying, but hoping to make it a nostalgic tearful eye that everyone likes)

plot:

You had a dream, but you found that you couldn't wake up, and the contents of the dream were very strange. You could only explore step by step and finally return to that restless city Do you really want to go back?

playing method

Strange Dreams "will enhance gameplay by setting up various fun mini game levels, not limited to finding different or walking simulators. Stay tuned!!

legal_notice:
1. Age classification and content disclosure

This game has passed PEGI Level 12 certification (or ESRB T) and includes the following content:
Threshold space scenes, abstract monster core art expression, and nostalgic melancholy atmosphere may trigger emotional resonance
Mild chase battle (without bloody violence)
Partial clean core/toilet core scenes contain blurred abstract visual stimuli
Note: Chinese Mainland version needs to apply for another version number, and the current version does not include the function of internal purchase

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: You had a dream, but you found that you couldn't wake up, and the content of the dream was very strange. Everything reasonable but unreasonable will happen here. You can only explore step by step, and finally choose to return to that restless urban era Do you really want to go back?
